selection: Ten different subject and material families chosen before reading their outcome labels; exclude the five current packing repair cases. Prior unrelated project experiments may include these questions.

requests.question: Will the Royal Mail raise prices on any letters or parcels before September 10, 2026?
requests.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves as **Yes** if, after August 10, 2026 and before September 10, 2026, Royal Mail Group announces a newly scheduled increase of any of these [prices](https://www.royalmail.com/sites/royalmail.com/files/2026-06/online-price-guide-july-2026-v2.pdf):

| Category | Service              | Price from |
| -------- | -------------------- | ---------: |
| Letters  | 1st Class            |      £1.80 |
| Letters  | 1st Class Signed For |      £3.80 |
| Letters  | 2nd Class            |        91p |
| Letters  | 2nd Class Signed For |      £2.91 |
| Parcels  | 1st Class            |      £5.15 |
| Parcels  | Tracked 24           |      £4.65 |
| Parcels  | express24            |     £12.50 |
| Parcels  | expressAM            |     £16.50 |
| Parcels  | express10            |     £28.10 |
| Parcels  | 2nd Class            |      £3.95 |
| Parcels  | Tracked 48           |      £3.65 |
| Parcels  | express48            |     £11.95 |
| Parcels  | express48large       |     £51.65 |
requests.background:
The Royal Mail, which traces its [history](https://www.postalmuseum.org/blog/delivering-the-post-the-beginning-of-the-postal-network/) back to 1516 when King Henry VIII appointed a Master of the Posts, held a monopoly in the United Kingdom on [letters](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2005/feb/18/postalservice) until 2005, when the post was opened to competition. Royal Mail [IPOed](https://www.bbc.com/news/business-24488144) in October 2013 at a £3.3 billion valuation. In April 2025 it was[ bought out ](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy4v5w1xd80o)and taken private for not much more than that by Czech billiionaire [Daniel Křetínský](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2024/dec/16/who-is-daniel-kretinsky-the-new-boss-of-royal-mail). 

Though the Royal Mail normally announces price increases in April, in the past three years it has also announced price increases in September:

* September 5, 2023: [First-class UK stamp to rise by 15p in October to £1.25](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2023/sep/05/first-class-uk-stamp-to-rise-by-15p-in-october)
* September 6, 2024: [Price of a UK first-class stamp to rise to £1.65 in October](https://www.theguardian.com/business/article/2024/sep/06/price-uk-first-class-stamp-rise-royal-mail-letter)
* September 24, 2025: [Royal Mail unveils price increases for October](https://www.cep-research.com/2025/09/24/royal-mail-unveils-price-increases-for-october/)[](https://www.cep-research.com/2025/09/24/)

requests.question: Will California Emissions Reporting Laws SB 253 and SB 261 Be In Effect on September 1, 2026?
requests.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as Yes if both the Climate Corporate Data Accountability Act (SB 253) and the Climate-Related Financial Risk Act (SB 261) are in effect on September 1, 2026 (UTC +7:00).

requests.question: Will a hurricane make landfall in the continental United States before September 1, 2026?
requests.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if, before September 1, 2026, according to [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) such as the U.S. [National Hurricane Center](https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/cyclones/), the center of a tropical cyclone reaches the coastline of the continental United States with sustained winds of at least 64 knots (74 mph or 119 km/hr).
requests.background:
May 2026: [NOAA predicts below-normal 2026 Atlantic hurricane season](https://www.noaa.gov/news-release/noaa-predicts-below-normal-2026-atlantic-hurricane-season)

> Forecasters with NOAA’s National Weather Service are predicting a below-normal hurricane season for the Atlantic basin this year. NOAA’s outlook for the 2026 Atlantic hurricane season, which runs June 1 to November 30, predicts a 35% chance of a near-normal season, a 10% chance of an above-normal season, and a 55% chance of a below-normal season.

> The agency is forecasting a total of 8-14 named storms (winds of 39 mph or higher). Of those, 3-6 are forecast to become hurricanes (winds of 74 mph or higher), including 1-3 major hurricanes (category 3, 4 or 5 with winds of 111 mph or higher). NOAA has a 70% confidence in these ranges. An average season has 14 named storms with seven hurricanes, including three major hurricanes.

requests.question: Will Starlink's website show India as a country with Starlink availability before September 2026?
requests.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as Yes if, before September 1, 2026, the [Starlink Availability Map](https://www.starlink.com/us/map) has anywhere in India listed as "Available."
requests.background:
SpaceX's Starlink, now available in over 160 countries, has had the technical feasibility to operate in India but has been stymied for 5 years to gain regulatory approval. According to [Advanced Television](https://www.advanced-television.com/2026/04/21/starlink-struggling-for-approval-on-south-africa-india/):

> Starlink first applied for permission to operate over India in November 2021 and is still waiting for approval. The latest reports suggest that its Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) application has “been put on hold” by the Indian government with reports saying that Starlink is a threat to national security concerns.

> One report from an independent observer said: “India doesn’t want to approve Starlink. They just don’t want to spit out formally. Their delay tactics are a decoy; powerful people control their communications, influencing the government. I doubt Starlink will ever be approved there.”

> Another comment from an anonymous contributor on India’s *Economic Times* website stated: “People aware of the details said the foreign direct investment (FDI) application of Starlink is currently on hold and can even be rejected if the government’s queries aren’t satisfactorily addressed. There are questions around cross holding in parent SpaceX and some other technical parameters.”

> A few weeks ago, senior executives from SpaceX met Indian Telecom Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia as the company advanced plans to launch satellite internet services in India. The delegation included SpaceX president/COO Gwynne Shotwell and VP/Global Business Lauren Dreyer, who discussed the company’s India strategy with the minister.

> Separately, SpaceX signed an agreement with the Government of Meghalaya to pilot Starlink high-speed satellite internet services in the state.

At the time of this question, Starlink's availability map had the entirety of India, including Meghalaya, listed as "Pending regulatory approval."

requests.question: Will Virgin Galactic have a "Going Concern" substantial doubt statement in its 10-Q SEC filing for Q2 2026?
requests.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if, in its 10-Q SEC [filing](https://www.sec.gov/edgar/browse/?CIK=1706946) for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2026, Virgin Galactic Holdings, Inc. has a statement expressing substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern, pursuant to [ASC 205-40](https://viewpoint.pwc.com/dt/us/en/pwc/accounting_guides/financial_statement_/financial_statement___18_US/chapter_24_risks_and_US/245_going_concern_US.html).

requests.question: Will Hakainde Hichilema receive at least 65% of the vote in the first round of Zambia's 2026 presidential election?
requests.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if President Hakainde Hichilema receives 65% or more of the first round votes in the [2026 Zambian presidential election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Zambian_general_election). The question resolves based on [official results](https://www.elections.org.zm/) or [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions).

requests.question: Will July 2026 be the warmest July on record, according to Copernicus?
requests.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** July 2026 is the warmest July on record in the ERA5 [dataset](https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/datasets/reanalysis-era5-single-levels?tab=overview), according to the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) monthly [Climate Bulletin](https://climate.copernicus.eu/climate-bulletin) covering July 2026.
requests.background:
According to the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S):

> The C3S mission is to support adaptation and mitigation policies of the European Union by providing consistent and authoritative information about climate change. We offer free and open access to climate data and tools based on the best available science. We listen to our users and endeavour to help them meet their goals in dealing with the impacts of climate change.

July 2023 set a record for the warmest July at the time, with a global average surface air temperature of 16.95°C, which was 0.72°C above the 1991–2020 average and approximately 1.48°C above the 1850–1900 pre-industrial baseline.

July 2024 was the second-warmest July on record at 16.91°C, which was 0.68°C above 1991–2020 (only 0.04°C cooler than July 2023).

July 2025 was 16.68°C, the third warmest July at the time. 

In 2026, monthly anomalies vs. 1991–2020 have been moderate compared to 2023–24:

\- February 2026: +0.53°C (5th warmest February)

\- March 2026: +0.53°C (4th warmest March)

\- April 2026: +0.52°C (3rd-warmest April)

In the second half of 2026, the El Niño Southern Oscillation (ENSO) is [forecast](https://www.noaa.gov/news-release/el-nino-forms-expected-to-strengthen-say-noaa-forecasters) to transition to a "very strong" El Niño, which could put significant upward pressure on global temperatures.

requests.question: Will the winner of the 2026 FIFA World Cup be a country that has never won before?
requests.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as **Yes** if the winner of [2026 FIFA World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_FIFA_World_Cup) is a country other than Uruguay, Italy, Germany, Brazil, England, Argentina, France, or Spain.
requests.background:
The [FIFA World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIFA_World_Cup) is a quadrennial [football](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Association_football) competition organised by FIFA. The [2026 edition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_FIFA_World_Cup), set to be jointly hosted Canada, Mexico and the United States, will take place from June 11 to July 19 2026.

Despite beginning in 1930 and hosting competitions every 4 years, outside of World War 2, only a total of [8 countries](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_FIFA_World_Cup_finals) have ever won the title.

requests.question: Will Shakira's "Dai Dai" outpeak Shakira's "Waka Waka" on the Billboard Hot 100?
requests.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves **Yes** if "Dai Dai" by Shakira & Burna Boy achieves a peak position on the Billboard Hot 100 (US) of #37 or higher at any point on or before July 31, 2026.

The peak position will be determined according to the weekly [Billboard Hot 100 charts](https://www.billboard.com/charts/hot-100/).
requests.background:
The [2026 FIFA World Cup](https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026) will be co-hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico, with matches scheduled from June 11 to July 19, 2026. It will be the first World Cup to feature 48 teams and the first co-hosted by three nations.

On May 14, 2026, FIFA released ["Dai Dai"](https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/shakira-burna-boy-dai-dai-official-song) by Shakira and Burna Boy as the Official FIFA World Cup 2026 Song, in support of the FIFA Global Citizen Education Fund. The song was unveiled at the Maracana Stadium and released globally across streaming platforms.

The benchmark for this question is Shakira's ["Waka Waka (This Time for Africa)"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waka_Waka_\(This_Time_for_Africa\)), the official song of the 2010 FIFA World Cup in South Africa. Waka Waka peaked at **#38 on the US** [Billboard Hot 100](https://www.billboard.com/charts/hot-100/). It became the best-selling World Cup song of all time and one of the most-viewed music videos on YouTube, with multi-platinum certifications in numerous markets.

For comparison, here is how the official songs of the three most recent tournaments performed on the US Hot 100:

* **2014 Brazil** — ["We Are One (Ole Ola)"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/We_Are_One_\(Ole_Ola\)) by Pitbull, Jennifer Lopez & Claudia Leitte peaked at **#11** on the Hot 100 (the only post-2010 World Cup song to outpeak Waka Waka).
* **2018 Russia** — ["Live It Up"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Live_It_Up_\(Nicky_Jam_song\)) by Nicky Jam, Will Smith & Era Istrefi did not chart on the Hot 100.
* **2022 Qatar** — ["Hayya Hayya (Better Together)"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hayya_Hayya_\(Better_Together\)) and ["Tukoh Taka"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tukoh_Taka) neither charted on the Hot 100.
  Several factors may influence "Dai Dai"'s chart performance.

The tournament being co-hosted by the United States, the world's largest music market and the basis for the Billboard Hot 100, could increase the likelihood of a US chart hit. Shakira herself has an established US chart presence, and Burna Boy is one of the most globally successful Afrobeats artists, having previously charted on the Hot 100.

requests.question: Will Anthropic file an initial registration statement (S-1) with the SEC to launch an IPO, before September 2026?
requests.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if Anthropic, or any subsidiary directly involved in the creation or commercialization of Claude, files a public, non-confidential [SEC Form S-1](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/s/sec-form-s-1.asp) at the U.S. Security and Exchange Commission's [EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/search-filings) database with a filing date before September 1, 2026.
requests.background:
CNBC: Anthropic confidentially files IPO prospectus with SEC, prepping Wall Street for landmark AI deal

> Anthropic said it confidentially filed its IPO prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Commission, setting up a potentially historic share sale for investors ready to jump into artificial intelligence.

> “This gives us the option to go public after the SEC completes its review,” Anthropic said in a statement on Monday. “The proposed initial public offering will depend on market conditions and other factors.”

> With its announcement, Anthropic is getting out ahead of rival OpenAI, which is readying its own confidential filing. Elon Musk’s SpaceX has officially filed its prospectus and is gearing up for a roadshow this week, with plans to debut next week.

> Submitting a confidential prospectus doesn’t lock Anthropic into a certain timeframe for going public. Its official prospectus just has to land in the hands of investors at least 15 days before the company begins a roadshow. SpaceX submitted its confidential filing on April 1 and disclosed its public prospectus on May 20.
